INITIALISE.title: Load revenues and allocation drivers
INITIALISE.rule: Read authorized inputs and existing outputs for the selected category/output periods. Include explicitly selected mapping/lookback periods for reference reads. Separate revenue, geography, supplier and material mappings into complete working tables.
INITIALISE.check: Confirm the read diagnostics, period scope, source row counts and amounts. Empty inputs do not establish calculation equivalence.

ENRICH_REVENUES.title: Assign reporting dimensions
ENRICH_REVENUES.rule: Apply product-type overwrite, product revenue group, account connection-region mapping, L1/L2 mapping, material remap, material group and regulatory service. Material-group revenue group overrides product-type revenue group only when populated. Preserve the exact original lookup order.
ENRICH_REVENUES.check: Trace a material/account with both specific and default mappings. Verify the winning mapping and any unchanged default.

CONSOLIDATE.title: Combine billed and unbilled revenue
CONSOLIDATE.rule: Combine the SAP revenue key figures at the original reporting grain by grouping out the key figure. Other dimensions remain as in the original calculation.
CONSOLIDATE.check: Compare the complete signed total before and after grouping; do not reverse revenue signs.

LOCATION_ALLOC_METHOD.title: Choose the geography driver
LOCATION_ALLOC_METHOD.rule: Choose the first available source: RSP material, RSP account, CAL account, CAL connection-region split. If none exists, retain the original not-found method. The method is recorded separately from the ratio.
LOCATION_ALLOC_METHOD.check: Use examples covering each precedence level and no-match. Presence of a matching row determines precedence, not a newly invented nonzero test.

LOCATION_ALLOC_RATIOS.title: Resolve geography percentages
LOCATION_ALLOC_RATIOS.rule: Load all geography rows from the chosen source. For material ratios, explicit location overwrite wins over normal RSP billing. Keep original geography members and amounts.
LOCATION_ALLOC_RATIOS.check: Check the selected method, overwrite trail and resulting ratio rows. Report unexpected totals; do not silently normalize.

ALLOC_RSP_BILLED_DATA.title: Recognize billing already split by geography
ALLOC_RSP_BILLED_DATA.rule: Use RSP billing with product type and document types RS, AD and AC. Exclude TBD and unassigned UFB reporting categories. Group the original dimensions and apply the same reporting mappings.
ALLOC_RSP_BILLED_DATA.check: Reconcile included billing and excluded document/reporting categories.

REMAINING_RSP_BILLING.title: Allocate the remaining billed revenue
REMAINING_RSP_BILLING.rule: Subtract already split RSP billing from total SAP billed revenue. Apply geography drivers to the remaining signed balance using the original matching dimensions.
REMAINING_RSP_BILLING.check: Already split billing plus allocated remainder must reconcile to the original billed base at the original grain.

RSP_NOT_BILLED_LOCATION.title: Allocate unbilled revenue by geography
RSP_NOT_BILLED_LOCATION.rule: Apply the selected geography ratios to SAP unbilled/accrual revenue and retain the original key-figure tags and signed arithmetic.
RSP_NOT_BILLED_LOCATION.check: Trace a positive and a negative accrual. Check missing driver behavior against the original.

FFLAS_GROUPING.title: Choose FFLAS mapping and monthly percentages
FFLAS_GROUPING.rule: Look up FFLAS grouping by material first. Only when that grouping is absent use account grouping. Resolve the monthly ratio within the corresponding material/account branch, preserving original precedence.
FFLAS_GROUPING.check: Verify material-versus-account precedence and missing monthly percentages separately.

PQ_ID_FFLAS_REVENUE.title: Split revenue into PQ, ID-only and non-FFLAS
PQ_ID_FFLAS_REVENUE.rule: Use geography to identify PQ versus ID-only revenue, multiply by the monthly FFLAS percentage, and calculate non-FFLAS as the residual of revenue by geography less allocated FFLAS revenue.
PQ_ID_FFLAS_REVENUE.check: Reconcile allocated FFLAS plus non-FFLAS to the geography revenue. Inspect partial percentages and signed residuals.

PQ_FFLAS_RATIO.title: Calculate the PQ share
PQ_FFLAS_RATIO.rule: Group PQ FFLAS revenue and divide by total FFLAS revenue at the original time/account/material grain. Use native SAP precision and the existing divide behavior.
PQ_FFLAS_RATIO.check: Inspect numerator, denominator, zero-denominator behavior and the resulting PQ ratio.

SUPPLIER_ALLOC_METHOD.title: Choose the supplier driver
SUPPLIER_ALLOC_METHOD.rule: Choose RSP material/account supplier ratios before CAL supplier ratios, preserving the original lookup keys and waterfall order. Store the chosen method separately.
SUPPLIER_ALLOC_METHOD.check: Trace a material-specific match, account fallback, CAL fallback and no-match.

SUPPLIER_ALLOC_RATIOS.title: Resolve supplier percentages
SUPPLIER_ALLOC_RATIOS.rule: Load the supplier rows from the chosen ratio source and preserve the original winning-supplier members and sorting keys.
SUPPLIER_ALLOC_RATIOS.check: Confirm the supplier source, member IDs and ratio rows before multiplication.

ALLOC_ID_REV_SUPPLIER.title: Allocate ID-only revenue by supplier
ALLOC_ID_REV_SUPPLIER.rule: Replace each matching ID-only allocated revenue row with supplier splits. When no supplier driver exists, keep the original row as the original calculation does.
ALLOC_ID_REV_SUPPLIER.check: Reconcile the replaced row to its splits and verify no-driver rows are retained.

PRICE_MATERIAL_LEVEL.title: Attach SAP prices to materials
PRICE_MATERIAL_LEVEL.rule: Match SAP prices to consolidated revenues by time and material. Emit the original price key figure and native amount for each matched row.
PRICE_MATERIAL_LEVEL.check: Trace matched and unmatched prices without treating price totals as revenue totals.

HSNS_REV_ALLOC.title: Reallocate HSNS premium revenue
HSNS_REV_ALLOC.rule: Credit the original HSNS allocation, rebuild from uploaded billing, map bandwidth to the associated access/rental group, and split accrual using material-level billing ratios before material-group fallback. Apply configured supplier exclusions at the original stage.
HSNS_REV_ALLOC.check: Reconcile credits/replacement revenue. Verify a material with only ID-only billing does not acquire PQ through a blended group fallback.

FFLAS_RATIOS_BY_MATERIAL.title: Calculate material FFLAS ratios and skipped flags
FFLAS_RATIOS_BY_MATERIAL.rule: Build SAP revenue denominators; create DEMREVID052 flags for suppressed material groups before excluding them. Divide allocated FFLAS revenue by the remaining base, assign residual to non-FFLAS, and add rounding discrepancy to the same existing row selected by the original ordering.
FFLAS_RATIOS_BY_MATERIAL.check: Ratios reconcile to one for nonzero eligible bases. Suppressed combinations have flags rather than ratios. Test rounding, negative bases, zero bases and both suppression settings.

TRANSPOSE_REVENUES.title: Prepare the revenue reporting layout
TRANSPOSE_REVENUES.rule: Group allocated revenue into the original summary dimensions, apply PQ supplier clearing and material-remap rules, and suppress configured hidden material groups.
TRANSPOSE_REVENUES.check: Reconcile visible summaries to the underlying allocation while explaining intentional hidden groups.

TRANSPOSE_PRICES.title: Prepare the price reporting layout
TRANSPOSE_PRICES.rule: Build connection and monthly prices at the original summary grain and preserve the existing product/member selection and lookup rules.
TRANSPOSE_PRICES.check: Review example connection and rental products; compare exact prices with the original output.

TRANSPOSE_CONNECTIONS.title: Calculate opening and closing connections
TRANSPOSE_CONNECTIONS.rule: Use stored fiscal prior/next links, exclude bandwidth connections, retain closing-to-opening carry-forward for materials with no revenue, and include additional connection adjustments. Keep output periods distinct from required lookback/reference reads.
TRANSPOSE_CONNECTIONS.check: Verify opening/closing amounts, no-revenue carry-forward and adjustment records. Do not infer a prior period by parsing a member name.
